tasks.label: 📦 Install dependencies
tasks.detail: Install everything the app needs (uses Bun — npm cannot install this project). Fast no-op once installed.

tasks.label: 🚀 Open Test App
tasks.detail: Start the test app and open it in your browser (http://localhost:4321).

tasks.label: 🎬 Open Demo
tasks.detail: Start Greenroom in read-only demo mode with seeded example data (http://localhost:4321).

tasks.label: ▶ Run tests (pick environment)
tasks.detail: Run all tests in the terminal; pick which environment when prompted.

tasks.label: ⏺ Record a new test
tasks.detail: Open a browser and turn your clicks into a test.

tasks.label: 📊 View last report
tasks.detail: Reopen the most recent test report.
